_meta.note: Stressor periods for the aggregate dashboard overlay. Dates checked 2026-10-10 against the pages in each period's source. Periods with verified: false are seasonal or public-health patterns with no Rutgers date, or a date that only one Rutgers page states.
_meta.campus_differences: Camden's last day to withdraw with a W is November 9, 2026 (NB and Newark: October 26). Spring registration opens November 9 at NB, November 5 to 13 at Newark by credits, November 5 to 11 at Camden.
